description.value:
To truly understand the mechanical advantages of an undead skeleton, you must understand how it functioned in life. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge] on living creatures with an internal or external skeleton using Undead Lore. If you do, you can learn only information pertaining to the biology of a creature—not any learned abilities or abilities granted by items.

Additionally, you can perform a forensic examination on a corpse using Undead Lore instead of Medicine if the corpse came from a creature with a skeleton.
